title: SI/PI Channel and PDN Evaluation Board
description: Designs bounded laboratory boards for passive channel characterization and power-distribution evaluation.
constraints: Preserve continuous return-current paths for controlled-impedance structures.
Expose assumptions that depend on the selected fabricator stack-up.
Separate measurement structures from auxiliary control and power circuitry.
evidence_requirements: Fabricator stack-up and impedance information when available.
Authoritative land-pattern and material constraints for selected physical interfaces.

verification: ERC and DRC findings are reported without concealment.
Impedance assumptions are marked for fabricator review.
Measurement topology and return paths receive independent review.
acceptance.delivery_policy: Deliver editable artifacts with explicit unresolved engineering risks unless an execution failure prevents valid KiCad files from being produced.
